summary: systemd options: daemon_reexec, daemon_reload, enabled, force symlinks, masked, name (defaults to .service), and no_block.
questions: How do I run systemctl daemon-reload with Ansible?
How do I mask a systemd unit?
How do I not wait for a systemd job to finish?

answer_card.title: systemd parameters (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `name` (aliases `service`, `unit`): `.service` implied; always give extension in chroots
- `daemon_reload` (false): run before other ops, even if nothing else changes
- `daemon_reexec` (false)
- `enabled`, `masked`, `force`
- `no_block` (false)
